feed.title: Panda Domi news
feed.subtitle: Now and then, news from the valley. No email, no account: your feed reader asks, and nobody learns who you are.

entry.title: The valley is painted
entry.summary: This page now shows the same paintings as the game itself: the old tree where the shy panda hides, the den, the farm, the keepsakes on the shelf and the real cards you will send to the family.

entry.title: The valley is open
entry.summary: A shy red panda has peeked out from behind its tree. This little page tells the story of Panda Domi: a cosy journal where you share the moment as a panda card, never a photo of your child. The free journal is being made now. This feed will say when there is something to try.
